title: Contribution Rate Tables by Financing Class
content:
The contribution rates of the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts are fixed per financing class: a new employer rate for the two new-employer classes, a reserve-ratio schedule for the two experience-rated classes, and an assigned rate for the delinquent reporting class. Reimbursing classes have no contribution rate.

## Fixed rates

| Financing class | New employer rate | Assigned delinquency rate | Reserve-ratio schedule |
|---|---|---|---|
| Contributory — New Employer Standard Rate | 0.0270 (2.70%) | 0 | none |
| Contributory — New Employer Construction Rate | 0.0395 (3.95%) | 0 | none |
| Contributory — Experience-Rated Positive Reserve | 0 | 0 | Table A |
| Contributory — Experience-Rated Deficit Reserve | 0 | 0 | Table B |
| Contributory — Delinquent Reporting Assigned Rate | 0 | 0.0870 (8.70%) | none |
| Reimbursing — Nonprofit Organization | 0 | 0 | none |
| Reimbursing — Governmental Entity | 0 | 0 | none |

A rate of 0 in the first two columns means the class does not use that kind of rate.

## Table A — Contributory — Experience-Rated Positive Reserve

| Reserve ratio floor | Rate |
|---|---|
| 0.1200 | 0.0030 |
| 0.1000 | 0.0070 |
| 0.0800 | 0.0110 |
| 0.0600 | 0.0160 |
| 0.0400 | 0.0210 |
| 0.0200 | 0.0260 |
| 0.0000 | 0.0310 |

## Table B — Contributory — Experience-Rated Deficit Reserve

| Reserve ratio floor | Rate |
|---|---|
| -0.0200 | 0.0420 |
| -0.0400 | 0.0510 |
| -0.0600 | 0.0600 |
| -9.9999 | 0.0720 |

## How a schedule is read

The rows of each schedule are ordered from the highest floor down. The rate is that of the first row whose floor the reserve ratio meets, that is, the first row whose floor is equal to or below the ratio.

**Boundary illustrations (hypothetical ratios).**

| Reserve ratio | Schedule | First row met | Rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.1000 | Table A | floor 0.1000 | 0.0070 |
| 0.0999 | Table A | floor 0.0800 | 0.0110 |
| 0.0000 | Table A | floor 0.0000 | 0.0310 |
| -0.0200 | Table B | floor -0.0200 | 0.0420 |
| -0.0201 | Table B | floor -0.0400 | 0.0510 |
| -0.0750 | Table B | floor -9.9999 | 0.0720 |
